a: काठिनं, --न्यं — 1 Hardness, tightness; काठिन्यमुक्तस्तनं Ś. 3. 10. --2 Sternness, hard-heartedness, cruelty. --3 Difficulty, obscurity (of style).

s: klI, (kaWinasya BAvaH । kaWina + zyaY .) kaWinatA । yaTA । “sIte mA kuru samBramaYca mfdunA kAWinyamaNgIkftam” । ityudBawaH ॥ (yaTA ca kumAre । 6 । 73 । “kAWinyaM mTAvare kAye BavatA sarvvamarpitam” ॥)
m: काठिन्य n. hardness, rigidity, stiffness, sternness, severity (N. of a disease), ŚārṅgS.
firmness of character, difficulty, obscurity (of style) Comm. on Pāṇ. vi, 1, 24; Vop. xiii, 1; Śak. 63; Kum.; BhP.
